beasts.name: Raaz (spirit rhinoceros)
beasts.description: Vaerak's rhinoceros, found dying, saved, befriended - and after its death bound into the Horn Hammer. When fully summoned it takes a body of water and living soil. Speed 20 m per round. Upkeep: 5 HP from Vaerak every turn it stays.

abilities.name: Charge
abilities.description: Moves at least 6 m straight toward a target, then slams it: 2d8 + 5 bludgeoning. DC 15 Strength save or the target is knocked back 3 m and prone.

abilities.name: Impale
abilities.description: Drives its horn through a target: 2d10 + 5 piercing and the target is impaled (grappled, escape DC 15). An impaled target bleeds every round.

beasts.name: Kaavor (spirit falcon)
beasts.description: Vaerak's falcon, found abandoned as a chick and raised by hand - after its death bound into the Sinew Lash. When fully summoned it takes a body of water and soil. Speed 90 m per round (flying). Upkeep: 3 HP from Vaerak every turn it stays. Can see in almost complete darkness; sees anything within half a kilometre in open sight and daylight.

abilities.name: Flight Dive
abilities.description: +3 to hit for every round spent gaining height; the bonus stays as long as Kaavor keeps the elevation. Dive strike: 2d6 + 4 slashing.

abilities.name: Focus
abilities.description: Kaavor keeps an eye on its prey (DC 10 to hold focus) and gains +3 to hit while it holds it. Focus is lost if Kaavor uses any action or ability except Flight Dive.

abilities.name: Talons
abilities.description: Talon rake: 1d6 + 4 slashing. Causes staggering on unarmoured enemies.

abilities.name: Keen Sight
abilities.description: Sees in almost complete darkness; sees anything within half a kilometre in open sight and daylight.

beasts.name: Giant Flamingo
beasts.description: Large beast, CR 2 (450 XP). AC 12, HP 45 (6d10+12), speed 9 m. Passive Perception 10. Two and a half metres, pink, used far too long as a croquet mallet - the neck is permanently bent into a striking pose. Its beak is sewn shut. In the queue at the Cross Door the two flamingos walk against the line: one step, one pause, and swing at every second turn (every third person).

abilities.name: Neck Swing
abilities.description: Melee attack: +5 to hit, reach 3 m (10 ft), 2d8+3 bludgeoning. (In the queue: DEX save DC 13, 2d8+2 bludgeoning and prone; half and standing on a success.)

abilities.name: Croquet
abilities.description: Recharge 5-6. One creature within 1.5 m: STR save DC 13 or it is hurled 3 m and knocked prone.

abilities.name: Rhythm
abilities.description: Passive. It swings only on every second turn and cannot change that. In combat this is as readable as it was in the queue.
